scope: Full cipher-feedback (CFB) concept article only; no completion claim for block-cipher-mode, CBC, OFB, AES, other modes or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 cfb 这一实体：段参数 s、密文反馈、IV 不可预测、串行加密与可并行解密、错误传播和无完整性；不把 AES、CBC、OFB、工作模式层或其他模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the cfb entity: segment parameter s, ciphertext feedback, IV unpredictability, serial encryption and parallelizable decryption, error propagation and the absence of integrity. It does not absorb AES, CBC, OFB, the mode layer or other modes.
